title: spergularia rubra subsp. rupicola
intro: Spergularia rubra subsp. rupicola, commonly known as the rock sand-spurry, is a plant species in the family Caryophyllaceae. It is used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating conditions such as fever, diarrhea, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Spergularia rubra subsp. rupicola are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, making it useful for wound healing and skin conditions. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
